# News 4 San Antonio

> > News 4 San Antonio (WOAI NBC) delivers local, national, and investigative journalism covering breaking news, crime, politics, and community stories across South Central Texas.

News 4 San Antonio is the NBC affiliate serving the San Antonio and South Central Texas region, providing comprehensive coverage of local government, law enforcement, traffic, weather, and human interest stories. The site features both breaking news updates and in-depth investigative reporting on issues including crime, public safety, and community welfare.

## Key Topics

- San Antonio
- Bexar County
- Breaking News
- Local News
- Crime and Justice
- Animal Cruelty

- Consumer Protection

## Local News & Breaking News

- [San Antonio News, Weather, Sports, Breaking News](https://news4sanantonio.com): Homepage for WOAI NBC News Channel 4 San Antonio local news
- [Local](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/local): Local news section for San Antonio and South Central Texas
- [Deputies arrest suspect in apartment animal cruelty case](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/local/deputies-arrest-suspect-in-rv-park-dog-cruelty-case-sheriff-salazar-says): Bexar County deputies arrest 22-year-old for dog neglect case
- [San Antonio leaders consider renaming César E. Chávez Blvd](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/local/san-antonio-leaders-consider-renaming-cesar-e-chavez-blvd-after-new-allegations): San Antonio debates renaming César E. Chávez Boulevard amid allegations
- [New testimony in trial of man accused of killing pregnant teen](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/local/new-testimony-in-trial-of-man-accused-of-killing-pregnant-teen-and-her-boyfriend): Christopher Preciado trial testimony reveals homicide investigation details
- [Blanco Road to close at Loop 1604 this weekend](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/local/blanco-road-to-close-at-loop-1604-this-weekend-ahead-of-diverging-diamond-opening-monday): San Antonio Blanco Road closure ahead of diverging diamond interchange
- [Dangerous Dogs](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/dangerous-dogs): San Antonio dangerous dog incidents and animal safety coverage

## Investigative & Special Reports

- [Spotlight on America](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/spotlight-on-america): Investigative journalism on healthcare, cybersecurity, and consumer protection
- [Addicted America](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/addicted-america): Opioid crisis coverage including fentanyl deaths and addiction recovery
- [Criminally Obsessed](https://news4sanantonio.com/criminally-obsessed): True crime podcast series covering murder cases and cold cases

## National & Political News

- [Nation & World](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/nation-world): National and international news coverage section
- [Beyond The Podium](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/beyond-the-podium): Political news and US politics analysis and coverage
- [Connect to Congress](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/connect-to-congress): Congressional news and legislative updates from US Senate and House

- [Pay It 4-Ward](https://news4sanantonio.com/features/pay-it-4-ward): Community service awards and local heroes in San Antonio
